draw: npx tsx scripts/sealed-law.ts draw --precommit sealed/precommit-4.json (drawLaw in this script at the commit above)
run: npx tsx scripts/run.ts sealed/clips/sealed-<round>.mp4 --narration "a block on a spring, filmed from the side" --sealed (one run each; refuses a dirty tree)
scoring: hit: the winner's term set equals the drawn term set (stiffness, damping and drive terms), where a fitted term whose constant is within 2σ of zero counts as absent, and each shared constant is within 2σ of the drawn value; pixel constants converted with the render's own scale; anything else is a miss. Reported apart: drive recall (driven laws found / driven laws drawn) and false-drive rate (undriven laws whose winner carries a drive term more than 2σ from zero)
